_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil statistics dominate: no 24h macro event, flat leg, and absent flow confirmation keep the next rung as current Anxiety rather than a forced directional break.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on current phase Anxiety; analyst explicit HOLD forward, narrative silent/low-conf so no directional split
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound, fear/greed ~32-46, no volume expansion next sessions
next_move.invalidated_if: >2% impulse with fear/greed <25 (down Denial) or ETF/stablecoin snap-higher on range break (up Complacency)
